flat.title: Flat
flat.sharedAccountNote: One account, more than one flat: each flat keeps its own payer, and a payment only settles the flats its payer is liable for.
flat.ownershipHint: Who owns the flat, with dates. Shares add up to 100 %.
flat.occupancyHint: Who lives here, with dates. Living here is not the same as owning or paying.
flat.bookingNone: No sale or booking record: this building was completed before the society joined, and a society keeps no sales records. Ownership, occupancy and payer are recorded separately above.
flat.liabilityHint: Liability is held per flat, with dates. A change starts from a month; earlier bills keep the person who was liable then.
flat.perUnit: Charges for this flat are always billed to the person liable for this flat in that month, even when the account covers other flats.
flat.whichRuleTitle: Which rule sets each charge for {{period}}
flat.whichRuleHint: The most specific rule wins: site default, then block, then flat type, then this flat. Approved exemptions apply after that.

chain.title: How this flat connects
chain.description: From the building to the statement. Open any step.

payer.title: Change who pays for {{flat}}
payer.history: The change starts from the month you choose. Bills already issued keep the person who was liable for them, so October's balance stays with the current payer.
payer.fromNext: Next month that has not been billed

problems.party: Choose the owner or a current occupant of this flat.
problems.firstOfMonth: A payer change starts on the first day of a month.
problems.periodPosted: That month is already billed. Choose {{period}} or later.
problems.same: That person already pays for this flat from that date.
problems.corrects: Only an approved change that has not started can be corrected.

payer.approvalNote: A change of who pays is checked by a second person before it applies. Bills already issued keep the person who was liable for them.
payer.correctingBody: When approved, this replaces that change. Both stay in the history.
payer.reasonHelp: Why liability changes (at least 5 characters). The approver and the history see it.
payer.requested: Change sent for approval: {{name}} for {{flat}} from {{date}}.
payer.changesHint: Requested by one person, approved by another. Nothing is overwritten.
payer.rejectEffect: Nothing changes; the request stays in the history with your reason.
payer.pageIntro: Every request to change who pays for a flat, and its decision.
payer.emptyBody: Payer changes are requested from a flat’s page (Flat 360 → Payer).

types.intro: The kinds of flat at this site. Charges can be set per type, for example a higher rate for penthouses.

list.intro: The sites your organisation is licensed for, with their flats and setup progress.
list.emptyBody: {{organisation}} has no building and flats here yet. Setting a site up takes four steps; the first is done by PropertyOS when the site is licensed.

site.title: Site licensed
site.body: PropertyOS adds the site and its blocks when your plan covers it.

list.emptyNote: Your plan today covers maintenance. Monthly dues and residents’ payments come with the community edition.

site.blockLine: {{floors}} floors · {{flats}} flats · {{vacant}} vacant · {{arrears}} accounts in arrears

collection.payeeHint: Residents pay the association here. It is shown on every bill exactly as below.
collection.title: Account title
collection.change: Changing it needs a second person to verify the new details.
collection.platformNote: This is the association's own account. The platform's account is never shown to residents and never receives their dues.

methods.title: How residents may pay
methods.hint: The payment methods allowed at this site. Office cash and cheques need a staff permission and arrive with collections.
methods.proofNote: A transfer proof is checked against the bank before anything is marked paid.

hints.bank_transfer: The resident transfers and uploads proof; the accounts officer verifies it
hints.office_cash: Received by staff at the office, with a receipt
hints.cheque: Deposited by the association, cleared before it counts
hints.online: A card or wallet payment through a payment provider

structure.intro: Every block, floor and flat, as the buildings stand. Open any flat for its 360.
structure.emptyBody: The site has {{blocks}} blocks and {{floors}} floors ready. Import the flat register to add the flats with their owners, occupants and payers.

import.intro: Bring in the society's flat register: each flat with its owner, who lives there and who pays. Every row is checked before anything is created.
import.uploadHint: A CSV file with one row per flat. The sample is the Al-Noor register, with three rows that need fixing and two repeated rows.
import.sampleHint: Fictional data. Nothing leaves this browser tab.
import.readError: That file couldn't be read. Choose a CSV file.

columns.occupancy: Who lives there: owner, tenant, vacant or office

import.alreadyBody: All {{count}} rows are flats that are already registered. Importing it again creates nothing.
import.alreadyShort: Already imported; nothing new to create
import.errorsHint: Correct the value, or use the suggestion. Nothing is fixed without you seeing it.
import.suggestionsApplied: Suggestions applied. Rows still to fix: {{count}}.
import.duplicatesHint: A flat appears more than once. The first row is kept; repeats are skipped, never merged.
import.dupOf: repeats line {{line}}; it will be skipped
import.dupExisting: already registered; it won't be changed
import.validHint: The first rows, as they will be imported.
import.allOrNothing: The import is all or nothing: while any row needs fixing, nothing is created. Importing the same file again creates nothing new.
import.ackFirst: Confirm that the repeated rows are skipped
import.committed: {{count}} flats imported with their people and accounts.
import.doneBody: Their owners, occupants, payers and billing accounts were created from the register. Next, import the opening balances.
import.doneNothingBody: All {{count}} flats were already registered; nothing was changed.

problems.flatPosition: no such flat on this site
problems.floorUnknown: this block has no such floor
problems.typeUnknown: not a flat type of this site
problems.phoneFormat: use a Pakistani mobile number, e.g. +92 3XX XXXXXXX
problems.occupancyUnknown: use owner, tenant, vacant or office
problems.payerVacant: a vacant flat has no occupant to pay
problems.accountHolder: flats on one account must have the same owner
problems.flatNotOnAccount: this flat is not on that account
problems.fileTooLarge: the file is too large for the demo

opening.intro: Arrears carried over from the committee's old register. The total is shown and approved by someone other than the person who imported it; then each becomes an opening-balance invoice dated as of go-live.
opening.noFlats: Import the flats first: balances are matched to their accounts.
opening.waiting: Waiting for the committee treasurer to approve it.
opening.waitingMine: You imported these, so someone else must approve them.
opening.confirmEffect: {{total}} across {{accounts}} accounts becomes opening-balance invoices, dated as of go-live. This can't be edited afterwards.
opening.returnEffect: They go back to {{name}} with your comment. Nothing is posted.
opening.importHint: A CSV with account, flat, amount and the go-live date. The sample has ten accounts in arrears.

people.intro: Everyone connected to the society, by what they are to each flat: owner, occupant or the person who pays.
people.emptyBody: Try another name, phone or flat number.

person.chooseBody: Open someone from Owners & Residents to see everything they are to the society.
person.liableLines: Only the flats and months this person is liable for are shown.
person.holderOnly: Account holder; other people pay for its flats.

roster.intro: Each flat with who lives there, who owns it and who pays. Change a payer from the flat itself.

errors.importHasErrors: Some rows still need fixing; nothing was imported.
errors.importHasDuplicates: Confirm that the repeated rows are skipped.
errors.openingPending: Opening balances are already waiting for approval.
errors.changePending: A payer change for this flat is already waiting. Decide or withdraw it first.
errors.notRequester: Only the person who requested it can withdraw it.
